name: next-expo-supabase-agent-harness
description: Subagents, commands, and the cross-surface vertical-slice + UI-design skills from the next-expo-supabase-agent-harness. The hooks, gates, permissions and CI belong to an installed project, not to this plugin: a plugin cannot carry permission rules, and the harness hooks run the project's own tools/ and validate chain. Install them with: npx --yes next-expo-supabase-agent-harness@latest init
